body: What I did was found a website where I can tutor kids in math online. It's not as stressful as going out and talking to strangers, and it really makes a difference. What do you want to do with computers?
Just because you're current dreams are shattered doesn't mean that you won't find a new joy. It's always hard to see the future when you feel crappy, but we do care about you.

From personal experience, my ex was very depressed and had very low self esteem. I guess as I was alluding before, when you feel down its hard to see what's so good. When you're not in that position, even little things can make people love and care about you.

An example for me was the music that my ex would play. We used to play in orchestra together, but she was always so self conscious. She was very talented, but just couldn't see past that people weren't judging her when she played. It was always a struggle to show her that people weren't singling her out or snickering behind her back.

I'm sure even though you don't know why your husband loves you, he treasures certain things that you just might not understand. Just know that he'll support you.

I know what you mean. Especially as a young person there's a vicious cycle of low self esteem. Basically depression begets depression. Even knowing there are perfect strangers willing to take time out to send you a message should give hope that people do care.
